examples.text: Mein Name ist Linda Conrads. Ich bin Autorin. Ich diszipliniere mich jedes Jahr dazu, ein Buch zu schreiben. Meine Bücher sind sehr erfolgreich. Ich bin wohlhabend. Oder besser: Ich habe Geld.
examples.translation: Je m’appelle Linda Conrads. Je suis écrivain. Je m’astreins à écrire un livre par an. Mes romans ont beaucoup de succès. Je suis aisée. Ou plutôt : j’ai de l’argent.

examples.text: Nach der Unruhe versuchte der Lehrer die Schüler zu disziplinieren.
Zu den beliebten disziplinierenden Maßnahmen gehörte früher das Fernsehverbot.
The most perfect, who have their passions in the best discipline, are yet obliged to be constantly on their guard.
The masters looked unusually stern, but it was the sternness of thought rather than of discipline.

glosses: A systematic method of obtaining obedience.

examples.text: Discipline aims at the removal of bad habits and the substitution of good ones, especially those of order, regularity, and obedience.
Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as his children. For what children are not disciplined by their father?

glosses: A state of order based on submission to authority.

examples.text: Their wildness lose, and, quitting nature's part, / Obey the rules and discipline of art.

glosses: A set of rules regulating behaviour.

examples.text: All she had done was give Teena a cilice, a barbed metal chain she was to tie around her thigh for two hours every day, and a discipline, a rope whip with knotted ends she was to use on her back when she prayed the Hail Mary.

glosses: A punishment to train or maintain control.

examples.text: Economics is a messy discipline: too fluid to be a science, too rigorous to be an art.
This mathematical discipline, by the help of geometrical principles, doth teach to contrive several weights and powers unto motion or rest.
